version.changelog: 0.3: renamed to "AKAI MidiMix probe" 0.2: all text in English 0.1: first version

version.author: The Eighth
version.changelog: 0.22: renamed to "AKAI MidiMix" (file, window, ReaPack); master mute / solo / pan (hold Bank Right); Bank hold jumps on release; double tap Solo restores the exact solo state; restart hint on collapsed Settings groups 0.21: width knob only works on tracks in stereo pan mode; the script no longer switches pan mode on its own (opt-in setting); window title in Akai Red; window never docks; Settings tab uses collapsible groups 0.20: window shows the master fader; fader scale follows the fader top; meters follow pan; fader top is +12 dB by default 0.19: mixer window redesigned in the style of the Akai MPC mixer, level meters, strip frames, modules in midimix/

version.author: The Eighth
version.changelog: 0.23: softer, a bit brighter 0 dB line; Help tab and hover hints; second mixer look in the style of the Akai MPC 2.0; Russian window (Settings > Window); settings group "Window" 0.22: renamed to "AKAI MidiMix" (file, window, ReaPack); master mute / solo / pan (hold Bank Right); Bank hold jumps on release; double tap Solo restores the exact solo state; restart hint on collapsed Settings groups 0.21: width knob only works on tracks in stereo pan mode; the script no longer switches pan mode on its own (opt-in setting); window title in Akai Red; window never docks; Settings tab uses collapsible groups 0.20: window shows the master fader; fader scale follows the fader top; meters follow pan; fader top is +12 dB by default 0.19: mixer window redesigned in the style of the Akai MPC mixer, level meters, strip frames, modules in midimix/
